description: Implementation of utility functions for Windows application, including exception handling, string manipulation, file I/O, color comparison, and UI thread operations within the Calculator app.

methods.name: IFTPlatformException
methods.description: Throws a Platform::Exception if HRESULT indicates failure.

methods.name: GetDoubleFromWstring
methods.description: Converts a wstring to double after removing unwanted characters.

methods.name: GetWindowId
methods.description: Returns the current window's application view ID.

methods.name: RunOnUIThreadNonblocking
methods.description: Executes a function asynchronously on the UI thread.

methods.name: IsLastCharacterTarget
methods.description: Checks if the last character of a wstring matches a target wchar_t.

methods.name: GetUniversalSystemTime
methods.description: Retrieves the current system time in a DateTime object.

methods.name: IsDateTimeOlderThan
methods.description: Checks if a DateTime is older than a specified duration.

methods.name: WriteFileToFolder
methods.description: Asynchronously writes text contents to a file in a specified folder.

methods.name: ReadFileFromFolder
methods.description: Asynchronously reads text contents from a file in a specified folder.

methods.name: AreColorsEqual
methods.description: Compares two Color objects for equality.

methods.name: EscapeHtmlSpecialCharacters
methods.description: Replaces special HTML characters in a string with entities.

methods.name: GetContrastColor
methods.description: Returns a contrasting brush (white or black) based on background color luminance.
